articles.summary: Canadian-built vehicle reduces emissions and offers a quieter, more immersive way for guests to experience the Athabasca Glacier as part of the Columbia Icefield Adventure Pursuit Attractions and Hospitality, Inc. (Pursuit) (NYSE: PRSU) today launched the world’s first electric Ice Explorer as part of the Columbia Icefield Adventure in Jasper National Park, Alberta, marking a thoughtful evolution in how guests experience one of the world’s most iconic and sensitive landscapes, the Athabasca Glacier. The vehicle is now operating as part of the regular fleet on the Athabasca Glacier, charging through onboard bifacial solar panels and regenerative braking. The pilot launches at a moment when Canada’s national parks are increasingly focused on how tourism can provide access while exercising environmental responsibility.
